goal_title: Particle tutorial: from a single mover to uncertain matter
why: Create a reconstructable five-hall Nature of Code particle path using existing Godot examples and a separate, explicitly speculative bridge to randomness/noise.
success_criteria: Five tutorial.md files each teach a representative independently reconstructable mechanism
Existing Particle/Emitter inheritance and source attribution verified
Predicted change, observation, reset and reconstruction in each hall
CPU/GPU/VR determinism limits and performance documented
Optional noise/randomness extensions do not silently displace the canonical five halls

tasks.title: Audit all five particle halls and real code inheritance
tasks.spec: Inspect commons/maps/sequences/particles.json, five commons/maps/Particles_*/map_data.json files, core/particle.gd, core/particle_emitter.gd, core/confetti_particle.gd, algorithms/particles/example_4_*_vr.gd, relevant .tscn files and artifact registry. Record actual source behavior versus planned exercises, keyboard-only controls, memory costs, reset paths, prerequisites from Forces and Nature of Code attribution/licensing. Note that the tracked particle hall folders currently lack tutorial.md. Do not generate tutorials until this audit.
tasks.verification: All five hall artifact tokens and code dependencies resolved or explicitly flagged

tasks.title: Build Tutorial 1: one particle, then an array
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Particles_SingleAndArrays/tutorial.md from the actual example_4_1_single_particle_vr and example_4_2_array_particles_vr. Begin with prior Point/Vector3/forces, explain the one new position/velocity/acceleration update, predict one outcome, reconstruct from complete new code and linked inheritance, then scale to an array and measured count. Demonstrate delta vs fixed-step timing. Provide a baseline, one variable change, reset, numerical observation and Quest-safe interaction.
tasks.verification: Cold reconstruction in isolated Godot scene; two expected parameter effects observed

tasks.title: Build Tutorial 2: emitter as a source over time
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Particles_Emitters/tutorial.md from example_4_3_particle_emitter_vr, example_4_4_multiple_emitters_vr, example_particle_body and sub_emitters. Explicitly teach rate, spawn point, initial velocity sampling, stored RNG seed, arrays and cleanup, plus a prediction about emission density. Identify desktop keyboard controls in source and provide a documented headset path or a blocking VR task. Do not claim an emitter rate makes physically random particles.
tasks.verification: Cold emitter reconstruction; stable particle count and reset; input test on headset

tasks.title: Build Tutorial 3: forces and fields
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Particles_Forces/tutorial.md from force_fields and example_2_6_single_attractor_vr. Derive force→acceleration→velocity→position with units and timestep. Compare saved initial conditions under constant force, random impulses and optional noise-field guidance (only after artifact prototype passes). Show actual flow geometry and explain stochastic versus deterministic field behavior. Use the same one-change trial protocol.
tasks.verification: Reconstructed field produces expected path/acceleration changes at two settings

tasks.title: Build Tutorial 4: lifetime, types and populations
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Particles_LifetimeAndTypes/tutorial.md from example_4_5_inheritance_polymorphism_vr, lifetime_curves and particle_systems. Show a complete new subclass or exact method replacement; reuse core/particle.gd by link. Compare fixed lifetime and a distribution of lifetimes with histogram and observed population size. Explain CPU educational implementation versus GPUParticles3D population visuals and do not promise bitwise GPU replay.
tasks.verification: Cold reconstruction with lifetime changes measured; Quest FPS/count comparison recorded

tasks.title: Build Tutorial 5: repulsion, collisions and campfire
tasks.spec: Write commons/maps/Particles_Collision/tutorial.md from example_4_6_particle_repeller_vr and particle_campfire. Build from earlier particles, force and lifetime examples. Explain repulsion versus collision, boundaries and integrated fire/smoke/embers; ask which visible features arise from which rule. Include an open-ended experiment that may fail and prompts a recorded new question instead of treating every result as an expected demonstration.
tasks.verification: Cold reconstruction from linked prior lessons; VR proximity and visual readability tested

tasks.title: Specify optional randomness and noise particle extensions
tasks.spec: Do not insert a sixth mandatory hall yet. Write a companion path using existing curl_noise_particles, particle_randomness_pure/perlin/emergent/patterns (registry/scene existence to be verified), and the proposed particle_field_comparator. Stage contrasts: independent draws, stochastic motion, correlated fields, flow, feedback and selection. Make each extension a branch from a relevant existing particle/randomness/noise hall; record unresolved prerequisites before enabling.
tasks.verification: No extension described as installed without corresponding map token/scene/VR evidence

tasks.title: Implement experimental run recording without false replay claims
tasks.spec: After approving the run-record schema, add opt-in record/restore hooks to one CPU particle example before extending across halls. Record initial conditions, fixed physics tick, force parameters, particle birth draws, seed/state and runtime version. Confirm replay within the chosen CPU model. Treat GPU visual effects, XR tracking and collisions as potentially nondeterministic without stronger snapshot or event logging; document exactly which outputs are reconstructed.
tasks.verification: Saved fixture test with parameter equality and measured tolerances; VR re-entry test

tasks.title: Run ghost-student and headset acceptance for all five tutorials
tasks.spec: For each particles tutorial, attempt a cold reconstruction from no undocumented source. Check inherited code links, accurate code replacements, scene load, lifetime/array cleanup, actual XR inputs, readout reach, reset, performance and experiment reproducibility limits. Record whether the student can predict an effect, perform it and explain its cause. Write blocked/unknown outcomes as learning debt; do not silently patch the instructions from private context.
tasks.verification: Five independent reconstructions and documented headset checks
